newsitem.title: USA: Conseco files for $1.5 billion shelf.
newsitem.headline: Conseco files for $1.5 billion shelf.

text.p: Conseco Inc filed Tuesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf registration to sell up to $1.5 billion in debt, common and preferred stock and preferred securities.
The trusts, known as Conseco Financing Trust IV, Conseco Trust V, Conseco Financing Trust VI and Conseco Financing Trust VII.
Proceeds from the sale of the debt and common and preferred stock will be use for general corporate purposes, Conseco said in the filing.

The business trusts will invest the proceeds from the offering of the preferred securities in subordinated debt securities of Conseco. Proceeds from the sale of the debentures will be used for general corporate purposes, the company said.
Conseco is a financial services holding company based in Carmel, Indiana.
